4f7b2d0b.text: If I'm writing notes like this, just into like a text box that's like a box right here is there a possibility to instead of just showing a normal text box like I would much rather want to get an interface to generate that best represents the content that I'm speaking into so how would I do? This first question is what are the types of interfaces that users will need from the text that they they say how do you then how do you infer the right interface based on what the user is speaking then how do you design the interface so that it still presents everything properly without getting in the way of what the users actually trying to say and trying to read what I'm saying I think this is another case of designing generative user interfaces rather than designing interfaces the design of a generative interface is going to be different from the design of a conventional one so I want to follow this same perspective in this kind of direction I thinking about what is a different interface design compared to the conventional interface? So the first question for that would be what is the conventional interface for displaying a bunch of text what are these interfaces like then how do you design the interface differently so that it affords better vocal voice input into the interface itself? I see two layers of connections to us. The first layer is a bit more of a lower layer where the connection is that this is pretty similar to being able to sketch user interfaces so there's possibly a way to incorporate both kinds of ways into generating an interface, and the interface that you generate might need to be designed differently. Maybe it's a different layout. Maybe you augment the interface different things maybe it's about encoding text and more visual ways or maybe it's about showing two interface at the same time where one is this traditional interface that you see and the other is the more the more it's a interface that tuned more to the modality that you were inputting there's another level to this where there's a connection to multi model generative interfaces where the generative interface design is actually about supporting multimodality. This would then encompass both of these two modalities of sketching, an interface, and also talking to an interface and the question then would become how much you design the interface touch that it affords multimodal input. How do you design a generative interface at a Ford multi model input?
